description: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Malfunction
student_hint: Inspect MAF sensor and intake for leaks

student_hint: Check for misfire patterns and run compression tests
possible_causes: Spark plugs, coils, fuel delivery, compression issues
diagnostic_steps: Read freeze frame, swap coils/plugs, perform compression test

student_hint: Check oxygen sensors and catalytic converter
possible_causes: O2 sensors bad, catalyst degraded, exhaust leaks

student_hint: Look for vacuum leaks and fuel trims
